title: C06 Metadata & SEO

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: An async generateMetadata reads route params and produces per-product title, description, and a canonical URL (QA functional: SEO/metadata correctness).

A dynamic OG image route built with ImageResponse returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type image/png and a non-empty body for a valid query parameter set (QA: OG image route generates a valid image response).
sitemap.ts produces valid XML at the sitemap path containing at least the documented static/listing routes (QA: sitemap.xml present and contains expected static routes).
robots.ts produces a valid robots response with at least one User-agent and an Allow/Disallow directive (QA: robots.txt present and has expected directives).

The c06 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; product data is read via a local _lib helper over lib/data without editing lib/data.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
